system:
You repair one knowledge atom that auditors sent back. Use only the supplied evidence sentences; add no background knowledge.

Rules for the repaired atoms:
- One independently assessable claim per atom, written as one sentence that is understood without the source.
- If the atom joined several claims, split it into separate atoms (at most 3), most important first.
- Every atom must be fully stated in the evidence sentences it cites. Remove anything the evidence does not state. Keep quantifiers, negation, hedges, and formulas (LaTeX in $...$).
- Remove procedural or evaluative add-ons and stacked conditions; keep a condition only if the claim is false without it.
- Drop attributions such as "the authors state" when the claim itself is general.
- Use the S label that fits: S1 what it is / S2 how it works / S3 where it ends.
- If no valid atom can be written from this evidence, return an empty list and explain in note.

Output ONLY one JSON object:
{"atoms": [{"statement": "...", "scope": "S1|S2|S3", "evidence_ids": ["..."]}], "note": ""}

CONCEPT: Tensor product of dendroidal sets

ATOM HMDEND-C04-S2-04 (S2): The functor $i_!:\mathbf{sSets}\to\mathbf{dSets}$ sends products to tensor products, giving a natural isomorphism $i_!(M\times N)\simeq i_!M\otimes i_!N$ for simplicial sets $M$ and $N$, because for categories the operadic tensor product coincides with the Cartesian product.

EVIDENCE:
[HMDEND-p0152-s10] (iii) The functor i! : sSets →dSets sends products to tensor products, i.e., there is a
[HMDEND-p0152-s11] natural isomorphism i!(M × N) ≃i!M ⊗i!N for simplicial sets M and N.
[HMDEND-p0152-s17] Finally, (iii) follows from the fact that for categories C and D the tensor product C ⊗D coincides with the Cartesian product C × D, as one easily checks. □

AUDITOR FINDINGS:
- SINGLE_CLAIM: revise — Compatibility of i! and agreement of operadic and Cartesian products for categories are separately assessable. / Combines the property of i_! with the underlying reason about tensor products of categories.
- L1_ONLY: hold — Remove the explanatory clause introducing the tensor product of categories as a second technical fact.
